newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines set fare increase.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines set fare increase.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said it raised fares over the weekend in all markets except its newest destinations -- Jacksonville, Fla., and Providence, R.I.
Southwest said full fares increased an average of $2 to $3 a ticket.
"Fares went up over the weekend to offset rising fuel costs," said Southwest spokesman Ed Stewart.
Southwest said surging jet fuel prices added about $25 million in costs during the fourth quarter, Stewart said.
The Dallas-based airline previously warned that higher fuel costs may also erode first quarter earnings.
Lehman Brothers analyst Brian Harris upgraded Southwest to outperform from neutral, citing the positive revenue impact from the fare increase.
AMR Corp's American Airlines later said it matched Southwest's fare increase in competing markets.
